title: How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills
author: Shilpa Kumari
description: As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team spotlights @r31n, diving into their research approach, favorite bug classes, and advice for aspiring hackers. The post How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team is excited to spotlight another top-performing security researcher from the GitHub Security Bug Bounty Program: @r31n ! As home to the world’s developers, GitHub is dedicated to the security and reliability of the code behind millions of projects, and our Bug Bounty Program remains a cornerstone of that commitment.
takeaways: As we wrap up our Cybersecurity Awareness Month celebration, we interview @r31n , a researcher renowned for their work on GitHub Enterprise Server, where they have repeatedly uncovered high-impact issues.
It exposes me to different products, technologies, and architectures I probably wouldn’t run into otherwise.
Security blogs, vulnerability write-ups, conference talks, proof of concepts, research papers, courses.
